calls.title: Workshop 3 - Admin Set-up - (Growthbook X Demandii)
calls.summary: The team outlined a strategy to elevate Graham McNicoll’s thought leadership primarily via LinkedIn, with specific goals to increase follower count, engagement, and secure speaking invitations. Graham will lead the thought leadership initiatives alongside Merrick, while Ryan will concentrate on demo content. The team will utilize humor and memes aligned with Graham's personality to differentiate their posts from typical LinkedIn content. A structured content approval workflow was established to ensure quality and reduce Graham's review burden, with Justin Slimm leading a one-round feedback process. Tools like Planable for content management and Shield for analytics were onboarded, supporting a strategic approach to content delivery. The possibility of using LinkedIn automation tools was also discussed to grow Graham's connections strategically, while risks associated with such tools were acknowledged. Initial coaching and video recording sessions were scheduled for early February to maintain momentum for content rollout.
calls.keywords: Thought Leadership, Planable, LinkedIn Analytics, Content Approval, Media Coaching, LinkedIn Automation
